_comment: Bank Indonesia policy-rate cache — the committed fallback for r_f across all three apps. Generated by portfolio-app/data/refresh-bi-rate.js (weekday cron .github/workflows/refresh-bi-rate.yml); also refreshed opportunistically by fetch-snapshot.js on a successful scrape. NEVER hand-edit: change the scraper instead. SEED STATE — `history` currently holds only the one decision known at authoring time; the first cron run backfills the full table from bi.go.id. Consumers must tolerate a short history: rateAsOf() flat-extends backwards and the backtest emits a coverage warning.
